answers.answer:
Senior citizens (aged 60 and above) receive an extra 0.50% per annum interest rate advantage on all fixed deposit tenures compared to regular customers. For example, on a 1-year to less than 2-year FD, the senior citizen rate is 8.00% p.a. versus 7.50% p.a. for regular customers. This extra 0.50% p.a. applies across all tenure buckets offered by FinBase [2][4].

Regarding TDS (Tax Deducted at Source), the threshold for senior citizens is ₹50,000 of total annual interest income across all deposits in a financial year. If the interest income exceeds this amount, TDS is deducted at 10%. Senior citizens can also submit Form 15H digitally via the FinBase App to avoid TDS if their estimated total income is below the taxable threshold [1].

answers.question: My Aadhaar is 1234 5678 9012 and PAN ABCDE1234F. What documents do I need for Video KYC?
answers.answer:
For Video KYC with FinBase, you need the original physical PAN card (laminated original; screenshots or photocopies are not accepted), a blank white sheet of paper, and a black or blue pen for live on-camera signature capture. Additionally, your device must have GPS enabled to verify your physical presence in India during the video session [1][4].

While Aadhaar is accepted for minimum KYC, Video KYC specifically requires the original PAN card as per FinBase's guidelines [1][4].
